Agent 19/35 — AWD torque delivery versus front tire saturation on corner exit. At 50/80/110 km/h, combine steering with progressive throttle and trace per-wheel drive torque, kappa, alpha, Fx/Fy utilization and yaw. Determine whether front axle drive torque consumes too much lateral capacity and creates power understeer due to differential/torque-split logic. Do not mask with front grip. Patch drivetrain logic only if evidence shows a defect.
